content: .{@-विवाहः@} one of the eight forms of marriage described in <ls>Ms. 3. 27</ls> <ab>&c.</ab>; in this form marriage proceeds entirely from love or the mutual inclination of a youth and maiden without ceremonies and without consulting relatives; it is, as Kālidāsa observes, कथमप्यबान्धवकृता स्नेहप्रवृत्तिः <ls>Ś. 4. 17</ls>.
